text: The warning for the data controller to carry out the acts requested by the data subject, under the terms provided by this Law, in the cases provided for in section I of the preceding article;
Fine of 100 to 160,000 times the Unit of Measurement and Updating, in the cases provided for in sections II to VII of the preceding article;
Fine of 200 to 320,000 times the Unit of Measurement and Updating, in the cases provided for in sections VIII to XVIII of the preceding article, and

In the event that the violations mentioned in the preceding paragraphs persist, an additional fine will be imposed ranging from 100 to 320,000 times the Unit of Measurement and Updating. In the case of violations committed in the processing of sensitive data, the penalties may be increased up to two times the established amounts.
